column3: Close to the Greek; the quotation is in capitals.
Close to the Greek; NASB has no “and saying,” like the critical text.
NASB follows the critical text with “He” (no “Jesus”); the quotation is in capitals.
NASB renders “in spirit” as “in the Spirit.”
NASB follows the critical text with “beneath your feet” (Textus Receptus: “a footstool for your feet”).
“To question Him any longer” is rendered “to ask Him another question.”
